title: •_Hound’s Tooth_
caption: •_Hound’s Tooth_ (V)
game_text: May add 1 alien pilot, 6 passengers, and 1 vehicle. Deploys (even using Combat Response) and moves like a starfighter. While Bossk piloting, adds one battle destiny and immune to attrition < 4.
lore: Controlled by state-of-the-art voice-activated X10-D computers. Internal sensors and security systems monitor prisoner activity. Modified for Bossk’s Trandoshan physiology.

notes: Unique. 'Hound’s Tooth' italic in the slip's title line and caption (marked _…_, as vs4/48 Stalker); curly apostrophe. Banner CAPITAL: MODIFIED CORELLIAN FREIGHTER. Stats POWER 5 / ARMOR 4 / HYPERSPEED 4; slip deploy 3 / forfeit 6 (printed 6 / 4). Scomp-link ring at the top-left of the text box → scomp true. Icon column top to bottom: blue spoked wheel → independent, red square with green dome → nav. Slip text matches the stub. Lore corrected from scan: 'state-of-the-art voice-activated' (wiki has a stray hyphen 'state-of-the-art-voice-activated'); curly apostrophe in Bossk’s — confirmed on the 745 px V0 remake. Base scan only at 350 px; copyright 1997 (Dagobah) not legible. Modern: V0-D-houndstooth.gif (745 px); VB2 -pre (350) also exists, not downloaded.
